name: GemmCoordinate<K>
description: a chain of K multiply-accumulates from c_0 = 0 on one tensor-core instruction's exact semantics (FP32 accumulation), then that target's epilogue

semantics.description: the exact tensor-core instruction whose accumulator step the chain uses (verity.ml.tc.instructions)

ir_definitions: GemmCoordinate_v2{K, DOT} (verity.ml.gemm); vLLM Gemm_v1 (N per token row, Ampere mma) and Gemm_v2 (Hopper wgmma) are N of them

sources.label: verity.proofs.target (GemmCoordinate<K>); backends/AGENTS.md: the decision workload, B = 4096 K = 1536 (frozen 2026-09-22)

work_model.basis: K multiply-accumulates (an FMA is 2 ops); the bf16 epilogue conversion is not counted (views.native, the tables' N)
work_model.source: verity.ml.gemm GemmCoordinate: K/16 tensor-core steps of 16 multiply-adds

fidelity_notes.note: H100 BF16 models mma (sm90.mma.m16n8k16.bf16); vLLM's H100 BF16 GEMMs run wgmma (sm90.wgmma.m64n8k16.bf16). On the H100 the two write the same words on every captured input, NaN and infinities included, so the gap is in the name only; gemm-coordinate/k1536/sm90-wgmma-bf16 names the instruction production runs

sources.label: docs ontology, Presentation rules (fidelity notes); verity.proofs.target BF16_HOPPER

lane wgmma-bf16 H100 runs r20260926-020157-242a / r20260926-020210-aee8 (wgmma, A from shared memory / registers) and r20260926-023321-ecb5 (mma.sync, a second H100): every word matches hopper_bf16_wgmma_k16's total step, 0 mismatches; the specials family identical word for word across the instructions; veritor's wgmma records replayed through mma.sync, 0 mismatches (packages/verity/tests/ml/test_wgmma_bf16.py)

stood_for_by.covers: its results (the H100 BF16 cells) and its input set, bench-instances-bf16-hopper-v1
stood_for_by.why: on the H100, wgmma BF16 writes exactly mma BF16's output words on every captured input, NaN and infinities included
stood_for_by.ruling: root, 2026-09-26 02:44Z: record the equivalence rather than duplicate cells; new real-K H100 BF16 cells use this subcircuit's id

sources.label: lane wgmma-bf16 H100 runs r20260926-020157-242a (art:8f903385, wgmma, A from shared memory) and r20260926-020210-aee8 (art:f9508ae8, wgmma, A from registers) on one H100; r20260926-023321-ecb5 (art:4ece89a0, mma.sync, a second H100): 25,833,472 swept elements incl. 6,144 specials, 0 mismatches against hopper_bf16_wgmma_k16's total step; veritor's 44,046 wgmma records replayed through mma.sync, 0 mismatches (PR #49, packages/verity/tests/ml/test_wgmma_bf16.py)

name: AttentionHead<T,D>
description: FlashAttention forward, one query head at the last position over its KV head (FA2 on sm80-class mma, FA3 on Hopper wgmma); the key count T varies per input
ir_definitions: AttentionHead_v3{T, D, BN} (FA2; vLLM Attention_v3 is NH of them)
AttentionHead_v2{T, D, BN, DOT, INV} (FA3; vLLM Attention_v2 is NH of them)

work_model.basis: QK^T and PV are T dot products of length D each (2*T*D ops apiece); the online softmax subtracts, scales and sums per key (3*T) with one exp2 per key; T is the input's key count

variables.T: the input's key count (varies per input)

work_model.source: verity_vllm.program.registry.b1.AttentionHead_v3 (FA2: DotBf16{K=D}, MufuEx2Ftz, F32FmaSubFtz, Fa2InvSum) and AttentionHead_v2 (FA3)

name: RoPEHead<D>
description: NeoX rotary embedding of one head with its bf16 cos/sin row
ir_definitions: RoPEHead_v1{D} (vLLM RoPE_v1 is NHEADS of them)

work_model.basis: each output element is x*cos +- y*sin: two multiplies and one add

name: RMSNormFusedCuda_v2
description: vLLM's fused residual-add + RMSNorm CUDA kernel on one row

work_model.basis: residual add (N), sum of squares (2N), scale by rsqrt(mean + eps) and weight (about N as fused multiplies): roughly 4N plus one rsqrt

name: RMSNormTriton_v1
description: RMSNorm on one row, the Triton kernel

work_model.basis: sum of squares (2N) and the scaled, weighted output (about N): roughly 3N plus one rsqrt

name: SiluMul_v1
description: SiLU(gate) * up on one row of the fused gate|up projection

work_model.basis: per output: silu(g) = g / (1 + exp(-g)) (an add and a divide) times up (a multiply)

name: GumbelTopPTokenSelect_v1
description: temperature + top-p sampling of one token: Philox Gumbel noise, top-p mask, argmax over V logits

work_model.basis: per logit: temperature scale, Gumbel noise -log(-log(u)) (two logs, an add), the top-p mask compare and the argmax compare; the top-p sort is not counted

name: TokenSelect_v1
description: greedy sampling (temperature 0): argmax over V bf16 logits, lowest index on ties

work_model.basis: one compare per logit (argmax, lowest index on ties)

name: MoeRouterTopK_v1
description: topk_softmax for one token row: f32 softmax over E expert logits with the kernel's reduction geometry, then TOPK lowest-index argmax rounds

work_model.basis: softmax over E logits (max, subtract, sum, scale: about 3E plus E exps), then TOPK argmax rounds of E compares

variables.T: the input's key count (varies per input)

name: MoeExpertCoordinate<K>
description: one output word of x @ W[e]^T for a (token, slot) pair (fused_moe_kernel, the w13 launch)
ir_definitions: MoeExpertCoordinate_v1{E, K} (vLLM MoeExpertGemm_v1 is N of them)

name: MoeExpertCoordinateW<K>
description: one output word of g * (x @ W[e]^T) for a (token, slot) pair (fused_moe_kernel with MUL_ROUTED_WEIGHT, the w2 launch)
ir_definitions: MoeExpertCoordinateW_v1{E, K} (vLLM MoeExpertGemmW_v1 is N of them)

work_model.basis: K multiply-accumulates and the routed-weight multiply

name: MoeSum_v1
description: the sum of a token's TOPK weighted expert outputs over H hidden columns

variables.T: the input's key count (varies per input)

name: ScaledMmFp8BlockCoordinate<K,G>
description: one bf16 output word of the blockwise FP8 CUTLASS GEMM: per K/G tile, G/32 Hopper e4m3 QGMMA steps from +0, scaled by the tile's two f32 scales and accumulated by FFMA

G.description: scale group size, a multiple of 32

ir_definitions: ScaledMmFp8BlockCoordinate_v1{K, G} (vLLM ScaledMmFp8Block_v1 is N of them)

work_model.basis: K multiply-accumulates over the e4m3 tiles, then per tile one scale multiply and one FFMA (3 ops)

name: BiasAdd_v1
description: element-wise bf16 add of a bias row (one f32 add, RNE) over N columns

name: Bf16MulScalarTensor_v1
description: bf16 row times a 0-d bf16 tensor: f32(x) * f32(s), one RN multiply, stored as bf16 (Gemma's embedding normalizer)

name: Embedding_v1
description: h[j] = table[tok][j]: one gathered table row (the spec treats it as a commitment opening, not arithmetic)

work_model.basis: a gather of one table row: no arithmetic (the spec treats it as a commitment opening)
